column3: Kuroneko Route · The Promised Day
...Wait, why do I have to talk to you about this?
...Huh?
If you think you're at fault, normally you should deal with it yourself.
Well, that's true, but... I'm at my wits' end, which is why I'm asking you!
Crap... The conversation earlier put her in a bad mood.
Well, I'll talk since there's no helping it this time.
Please, I'm begging you, I can't do anything just by myself.
I need your help! Please!
W-Well... If you put it that way, I guess I can't say no.
The promised day is drawing near.
Huh?
Until I accomplish my 'mission'... I have no time to play with mortals like you.
We will no longer meet until this is all over.
Huh? W-Wait, what are you saying?
This is all I have to say.
Ah, wait! Hold up...
Wha...
What was that about?
I don't get it either.
Well, I guessed as much.
I think she probably meant "I have something important to do so I don't have time to play for a while."
From Kirino's point of view, it means she won't be able to hang out with her anymore. She's unhappy about it.
You're not thinking of something that would irritate me, are you?
Nope, nothing like that.
As you've probably guessed... I will get angry if you dare say it.
No worries, I'm not so reckless.
Still, all I understood is that Kuroneko is busy with something...
How is that related to her with avoiding me?
I've been thinking...
I think she has some 【Important Goal】 in mind.
What do you mean by that?
I'm not sure, but I get the feeling she's trying to reach it all by herself.
Hmph, why is she putting in so much effort alone? Seriously, putting on airs when she can't do anything.
I see, I think I mostly get it now.
Kuroneko's trying to do something on her own. It's just a guess, but she doesn't want to bother others and hence distanced herself.
*stare*
W-What...?
We'd only end up quarreling if I were to talk to her...
...You, do something...
I heard you out, with that... Life Counseling, right?
That's right.
I'll think of something, so leave it to me.
...Hmph.
